description: A PostHog dashboard: a named collection of insight tiles with shared filters. Tiles are managed by attaching insights (PostHog::ProductAnalytics::Insight Dashboards) and are not part of this resource.

BreakdownValue.description: The breakdown value this color applies to, as it appears in the chart legend.

ColorToken.description: Palette slot to color the value with, as `preset-1` upwards. Not a CSS color.

BreakdownType.description: Breakdown type the value came from, such as `event`, `person`, `session` or `cohort`.

BreakdownProperty.description: Breakdown property the color is scoped to. Omit to apply it under every property.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the dashboard belongs to.

Pinned.description: Whether the dashboard is pinned to the top of the dashboard list.

Filters.description: Dashboard-level filters applied to every tile, as JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString): date_from, date_to, properties, breakdown_filter, interval, compareFilter, filterTestAccounts. E.g. {"date_from": "-30d"}.

BreakdownColors.description: Colors pinned to specific breakdown values across the dashboard's tiles.

DataColorThemeId.description: ID of the color theme (PostHog::ProductAnalytics::DataColorTheme) used for chart visualizations.

QuickFilterIds.description: IDs of the quick filters shown on this dashboard.

LayoutCompaction.description: How tiles rearrange after a move or resize: `vertical` stacks tiles upward, `horizontal` to the left, `stable` preserves positions.

GroupDisplay.description: How tile groups show: `sections` (collapsible bands) or `tabs`.

UseTemplate.description: Key of a predefined dashboard template to create the dashboard from. Only used on creation.

UseDashboard.description: ID of an existing dashboard to duplicate (tiles included). Only used on creation.
